findings.title: Frozen backlog hash is not bound to the immutable pause-commit blob
findings.reproduction: Hash the bytes returned by `git show 7c67ac9fdd39c4db2322cefd9ab5d603865d0efd:planning/backlog.yaml`; SHA-256 is ccad7c69d014e34e4efeb16e8870fc61b27030a554b68b4fe7e6c73eb175f00d. GRR-0002.packet.json instead records 4af88e9ec9556d0a55e0a69b15ce4e30d0b6e608112a1dbd83746d0fde2c1ddb, which is the SHA-256 of the CRLF-converted Windows checkout bytes. The 7c67ac9 and 97abcb8 Git blobs are identical LF byte streams, so the declared frozen hash is not portable or commit-bound.
findings.requiredRemediation: In a strict-descendant packet revision, bind frozenBoundary.backlogSha256 to the immutable Git blob SHA-256 ccad7c69d014e34e4efeb16e8870fc61b27030a554b68b4fe7e6c73eb175f00d, refresh the packet identity, and preserve this R01 review ledger append-only for bounded R02 replay.

findings.title: The packet's required Git-hygiene check fails
findings.reproduction: Run `git diff --check 7c67ac9fdd39c4db2322cefd9ab5d603865d0efd..97abcb857548d98f2e6c97f13fcd0f67d125248d`; it reports `planning/governance-recovery-requests/GRR-0002.md:121: new blank line at EOF.`
findings.requiredRemediation: Remove the extra blank line at the proposal EOF in a strict-descendant packet revision, refresh the proposal hash in the packet and the packet SHA-256, and preserve this R01 review ledger append-only for bounded R02 replay.
